name: Streamline Plastics
old_description: As a family-owned business since 1990 with 30+ years of experience, Streamline Plastics delivers consistent quality and dependable timelines.
about:
Streamline Plastics operates from Ogden, Utah, where it was founded in 1990 as a family-owned business. The company has remained under family ownership for over three decades, building its reputation on consistent quality and dependable timelines.

The shop provides plastic injection molding, blow molding, and a range of secondary services including part and mold design, mold building, packaging and assembly, kitting, bottle filling, and fulfillment. Its capabilities cover injection packaging, handled bottles in sizes such as 2.5‑gallon and 2.5‑gallon XL, and full fulfillment operations from kitting to shipping.

Customers include manufacturers who need reliable supply of molded components and finished goods; testimonials cite senior buyers, procurement directors, and sales directors who rely on Streamline for production-line parts, packaging, and assembled products. The company serves clients seeking to reduce inventory carrying costs and avoid production shutdowns caused by long lead times.

Streamline emphasizes clear communication throughout every project phase, transparent tracking from order to delivery, and quick turnaround times as its core differentiators. The firm positions itself as a partner that eliminates miscommunication, costly rework, and unpredictable supply chains.
built_on: Clear communication throughout the entire process
